cover.report_type: Seven days before a primary election

_meta.notes: A campaign EMAIL ADDRESS is printed in the clear on the cover (chunk-file flag confirmed). Per the brief it was discarded at read time and is written nowhere in this record. The cover's street-address block and phone number are covered by the county's black bar. Chunk-file values all CONFIRMED at the form: candidate Sim Gill, Office Sought 'District Attorney' (no district number field filled), report type 'Seven days before a primary election' (box ticked), 'No' ticked for amendment, form self-dated 6/19/18, clerk-stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE JUN 19 2018, printed title '2018 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' so form_year='2018'. STRUCTURE: this is an attachment-behind-stub filing on BOTH sides - the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p6) pages are present, print 'See Attached' in the first name cell, and are otherwise empty including their SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells. ORIENTATION VARIES WITHIN THE FILING: the two contribution attachment pages (pp.4-5) are landscape stored rotated inside the PDF and must be rotated CLOCKWISE (PIL rotate(-90)) to read; the expenditure attachment (p7) is PORTRAIT and needs no rotation at all. Geometry on every row is given in the poppler-rendered PORTRAIT frame, so for pp.4-5 a row's band is a narrow VERTICAL strip (x = the row's position, y/h = the table's column span). OCCUPATION vs EMPLOYER: unlike the county's own grid (one 'Occupation/Employer' cell) this filer's attachment prints TWO separate columns, 'Occupation' and 'Employer'. The 'occupation' field carries the Occupation cell VERBATIM; the Employer cell is preserved verbatim in each row's note, labelled, rather than being concatenated into a field the form does not have. Where a row's Occupation cell is empty the note says so. TWO CELLS ARE CLIPPED BY THE SPREADSHEET COLUMN WIDTH and are recorded exactly as printed, not completed: contribution line 3's contributor name 'Southwest Regional Council of Carpente' and contribution line 64's occupation 'Senior Vice President, Product an'. PRIVACY: the attachment prints Address / City / State / Zip as four separate columns and the county's black bar spans ALL FOUR on every row of pp.4-5, so donor_city and donor_state are blank throughout with 'redacted at source' in each row note - a different fact from the filer leaving them empty. Nothing was read from behind or beside the bar. FOR A HUMAN TO LOOK AT - p8 ('Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts', the county form) has 'NONE' written in its first Name of Contributor cell yet prints $6,000.00 in its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell, with the TOTAL cell blank. Re-read at 600 dpi: the figure is definitely on the SUBTOTAL band. This is an internal contradiction ON THE FILER'S PAGE. It is NOT counted anywhere in this record: the Other Campaign Accounts tables are a different scope from the standard Schedule A and are never interchangeable with it, and the standard side already closes exactly without it. Noted as a coincidence only, not a finding: the main Schedule A attachment does carry one $6,000.00 row (line 31, Carl Mergele / Perspective Software, 5/17/18). p9 ('Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts') says 'NONE' with both its subtotal and total cells blank. This filing carries NO 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts' page - only the two itemized Other-Accounts pages - so no Year-to-Date table exists here. IN-KIND is marked by the filer in an unlabelled column to the right of Amount reading 'In Kind': 9 contribution rows (1,219.39) and 9 expenditure rows (1,209.39). Both printed grand totals INCLUDE them (proved arithmetically, not assumed from the form family). The filer's expenditure attachment prints one row out of date order (6/15/18 between 6/8/18 and 6/14/18); kept in printed order.

contributions.detail: 115 rows over pp.4-5 sum to 60252.54, which equals BOTH the attachment's own printed grand total ('Total Contributions Period Ending 6/18/18  $60,252.54', foot of p5) AND Summary Page line 1 Column A. The county Schedule A page (p3) is a 'See Attached' stub with its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells blank, so no page-subtotal gate exists there. In-kind is settled arithmetically ON THIS FILING: the 9 rows marked 'In Kind' total 1219.39 and ARE included in the printed grand total (the total closes only with them), so this filing is NOT a schedule-total-vs-summary-gap case.

expenditures.detail: 44 rows on p7 sum to 31386.20 = the attachment's own printed grand total ('Total Expenses - Period Ending 6/18/18  $31,386.20') = Summary Page line 2 Column A. The county Schedule B page (p6) is a 'See Attached' stub with SUBTOTAL/TOTAL blank. The 8 'In Kind' expenditure rows (1069.62) are included in the printed total.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page subtotals exist anywhere on this filing: both county schedule pages (p3, p6) are 'See Attached' stubs with SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL left blank, and neither filer attachment prints per-page subtotals. The usable gate is each attachment's own printed GRAND TOTAL on its last page - contributions $60,252.54 (foot of p5), expenditures $31,386.20 (foot of p7) - and both close EXACTLY against the transcribed rows and against the Summary Page.
itemized.escalation_note: p4: four 600 dpi column crops (date/first/last x2 row-halves; occupation/employer/amount x2) plus two 600 dpi tail crops for the last 2 rows. p5: four 600 dpi column crops. p7: three 500 dpi row-band crops. p8: one 600 dpi crop of the SUBTOTAL band to settle the $6,000.00 anomaly below.
